_about: Public-domain George Webber (1838-1907), Canadian Methodist minister of Charlottetown and Ontario, for the Word Hoard: Lectures and Sermons, The Pulpit the Age Needs, and God in History. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 111 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
